correctness.rationale: For complex E_n spanned by full coefficient blocks (n), (n-1,1), (n-2,2), n>=4, the two-subset permutation character is binom(F,2)+T. Subtract trivial and standard characters to obtain chi_(n-2,2), dimension d=n(n-3)/2. Averaging left-right conjugates yields unique minimal full-isotype projector; complex finite l_infty injectivity identifies absolute and relative projection constants, equal to E|1+(n-1)(F-1)+d(binom(F,2)+T-F)|. Exact sign support T=0, F=0,1,2 (with small-n restrictions) and E K=1 give closed q_m formula. Directly enumerated all permutations for n=4..7 with exact fractions; observed 8/3,21/5,1211/180,6577/630 and exactly predicted negative strata. Character counting/recurrence and Cauchy estimate prove the universal formula and asymptotics; finite enumeration alone does not.
residual_risks: Relative and absolute constants coincide here by injectivity of C(S_n;C); no assertion for arbitrary subspaces or scalar fields.
Quantified n>=4 rests on the exact cycle enumeration and character algebra, not n<=7 test.
